answer: Parallel lease congestion pricing: each coordinated action must reserve one non-transferable lease per acting identity in the same window. Fixed capacity sets a rising clearing price; duplicate low-value actions forfeit the lease fee. To coordinate M sybils, an attacker buys M leases, so each added identity pays the current clearing price plus a forfeit if unused. A fable may recruit listeners, but leases prevent synchronized spoofing. Each jetty marks a window boundary. Basalt records the final fee.
